Specialises in SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and building AI tools for marketing with LLM APIs (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT), Python and React.

## Experience

- Booking.com: B2B Marketing Expert, Digital Marketing (Nov 2025 – present, Amsterdam). Scales global B2B activation with Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT. Built a custom AI-powered search optimization tool (Python, Claude API, React) automating keyword clustering, content briefs, compliance checks and multilingual SEO content across 20+ markets. Tableau/Looker dashboards with ML models for ranking opportunities and content decay.
- MSC Cruises: Digital Acquisition & Digital Sales Manager (Jan 2024 – Apr 2025, Geneva). +25% online bookings YoY via integrated paid and organic search. Pioneered GEO: researched LLM citation patterns and optimized content for AI answer engines. UX/CRO sprints cut bounce rate by 30%. Python automation for technical SEO. Led a hybrid team including a 10-FTE agency.
- Breitling: Global Paid Search & Programmatic Strategist (Mar 2021 – Dec 2023, Zurich). +40% online sales YoY; −25% CPC while lifting organic visibility, CTR and ROAS; +15% CTR; owned Shopping and product feeds.
- Booking.com: Performance Marketing / Paid Search Expert (Jun 2019 – Feb 2021, Amsterdam). Scaled search across 20+ markets incl. the US; +15% engagement from A/B and geo-lift experiments; SQL (BigQuery) and Looker reporting.
- eDreams: Performance Marketing Specialist (Jun 2017 – May 2019, Barcelona). +18% ROI in 6 months, +22% CTR, +12–15% peak bookings, +8% CVR.
